summary: 솔잣새처럼 소나무 숲에 사는 새로, 우리나라를 비롯해 일본, 중국 북부, 만주, 우수리, 사할린, 유럽 서부·중부·동부 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 스웨덴 북부, 시베리아 동부, 아무르, 만주 북부 등지에서 번식한다. 침엽수에 솔잣새와 비슷한 둥지를 짓고 한배에 알을 3~4개, 드물게 5개 낳는다.

similar.how: 큰날개덮깃과 가운데날개덮깃 끝의 5~15mm 흰 부분이 날개에 흰 줄 두 개를 이루어 쉽게 가려진다. 수컷 몸깃은 솔잣새보다 엷은 장밋빛이고, 암컷은 바탕색이 더 옅으며 등과 아랫면의 세로무늬가 또렷하다.

art.subject: Two-barred Crossbill (Loxia leucoptera), adult male in winter: head, mantle, rump and breast rose-red to pinkish red, more pinkish than the brick-red of most Red Crossbills; dusky lores and a darker area around the eye; lower belly and undertail coverts greyish white; blackish wings with two broad, clean white wing bars on the median and greater coverts, the lower bar the wider, and white tips to the tertials; tail black and notched, the outer feathers with fine pale edges. Dark grey-brown bill with crossed mandible tips, the sides of the lower mandible paler; dark brown eye; dark brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a pine branch, side view
art.scene: Korean winter pine forest; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view perched on a pine twig: rose-red body with greyish-white lower belly and undertail, black wings with two broad white wing bars, white-tipped tertials, fine pale edges to the black outer tail feathers, crossed dark bill with paler lower mandible sides

adult female, side view perched: greyish olive-green body with distinct dark streaks on the back and underparts, yellowish-green rump, the same black wings with two broad white bars, crossed bill, dark brown legs
art.build: Finch of about 15cm, a little larger than a sparrow and slightly smaller than the Red Crossbill; large-headed and stocky with a short, notched tail. Bill deep at the base, shorter than the head, with the tips of the upper and lower mandible crossing; slimmer than the Red Crossbill's bill. Legs short, dark brown, feet strong for clinging to cones. Clambers parrot-like among cones, often hanging upside down. In flight the white wing bars flash on black wings.
avoid: Do not leave the wings plain; both sexes have two broad white wing bars (plain wings mean Red Crossbill, Loxia curvirostra).
Do not draw a normal straight conical finch bill; the tips of the mandibles must visibly cross.
Do not make the male dark crimson or dull brick-red with brown wings, nor washed-out pale pink; the body is rose-red and the wings jet black.
Do not paint the wing bars thin or buff; they are broad and pure white.
